documents.title: Standards and Recommendations for the Use of Generative AI in Teaching and Learning at Northeastern
documents.summary: The July 2025 provost standards support faculty autonomy: instructors decide whether AI is prohibited, permitted, encouraged or required and must state this in the syllabus and assignments. It recommends aligning AI with learning goals, disclosure, redesigned assessment, no reliance on detectors, and committee review for AI grading and data-sensitive uses.

documents.title: Khoury College faculty on when — and when not — to use AI in the classroom
documents.summary: A news item on Khoury College's approach: AI-forward, fundamentals first, with each instructor deciding whether AI is forbidden, acceptable, suggested or required per assignment.
